# Immutable cycle91 Leo camp compatibility evidence

Copied natural cycle90/story/agent99/attempt01 entry snapshots for first (camp_1), followup (camp_2), settled (camp_3 and camp_4) at their actual times. These numeric IDs identify saved nights, not dialogue chapters. Each natural entry was loaded under pre-repair production and each of its two choices was paid once in an isolated fixture context. Result text, reader, full history, scene keys/time, effects/notes and receipts are frozen in baseline.json and eight paid JSONs. No fixture is a new persona journey.

SHA256.json protects all 13 baseline JSON files. make-fixture.cjs refuses to overwrite baseline.json. The full production opt-in is deliberately absent from these saved records. Tests remove only reading for additional old text-only replay checks; originals remain untouched.
